snippet:
Iframe Decoder for url vidstreaming. If you don't want to directly load the video iframe in your application, you can use the decoder. api.
A free, fast, and reliable CDN for gogoanime-api-new. Gogoanime is a custom API that provides data from the `10.gogoanime.io` website. You will have access to the entire catalog whether movies, series, current episodes, etc., with English subtitles.
